question: What physical transformations result from the wheel-based lotus visualization?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases
inference: This visualization frees the practitioner from aging signs and all diseases
uncertainties: Case mismatch between nominative valīpalitanirmuktaḥ and accusative sarvavyādhivivarjitam may reflect transmitted text
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
